Domain: Finance
Description: Lookup table containing standard ISO currencies.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): The official full name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar, Euro)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp indicating when the currency record was last modified or updated in the system
  - currencycode (character(3)) [PK]: The unique 3-letter ISO 4217 alphabetic code identifying the currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

--- Table 2: adventureworks.humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory ---
Domain: Human Resources
Description: Employee department transfers.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when this assignment record was last modified
  - enddate (date): Date when the employee ended their assignment in this department (NULL if still active)
  - startdate (date) [PK]: Date when the employee began their assignment in this department
  - shiftid (smallint(16,0)) [PK] [FK]: Identifier of the work shift during the employee's assignment to this department
  - departmentid (smallint(16,0)) [PK] [FK]: Identifier of the department to which the employee was assigned
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Unique identifier of the employee who was assigned to the department

--- Table 3: adventureworks.sales.customer ---
Domain: Customer
Description: Current customer information. Also see the Person and Store tables.
Fields:
  - customerid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key uniquely identifying each customer record in the system
  - storeid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key referencing the store with which the customer is associated, linking them to their primary retail location
  - personid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key linking to the Person table, identifying the individual person record that represents the customer
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier generated by the system for row-level tracking and data synchronization purposes
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key identifying the sales territory the customer belongs to, used for regional sales reporting and assignment
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the customer record was last updated or modified in the system

--- Table 4: adventureworks.sales.store ---
Domain: Store
Description: Customers (resellers) of Adventure Works products.

  - demographics (xml): XML document containing store demographic information including location type, sales territory, and business characteristics
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each store record for system-wide reference
  - name (character varying(50)): Official business name of the store or reseller entity
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the store record was last updated in the system
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key reference to the core business entity table containing foundational information about this store organization

--- Table 5: adventureworks.person.password ---
Domain: Security
Description: One way hashed authentication information
Fields:
  - passwordhash (character varying(128)): One-way cryptographic hash of the user's password used to verify identity during authentication without storing plaintext
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key reference to the person or business entity that owns this password credential
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the password was last changed or updated in the system
  - passwordsalt (character varying(10)): Random value concatenated with password before hashing to defend against rainbow table attacks and enhance security
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each password record for internal referencing and system integration

--- Table 6: adventureworks.sales.specialofferproduct ---
Domain: Promotion
Description: Cross-reference table mapping products to special offer discounts.
Fields:
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key reference to the specific product that is included in the special promotional offer
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each product-offer relationship for data synchronization and replication purposes
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the association between the product and special offer was last modified or updated
  - specialofferid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key reference to the special offer or discount that applies to the linked product

--- Table 7: adventureworks.sales.salesorderheadersalesreason ---
Domain: Sales
Description: Cross-reference table mapping sales orders to sales reason codes.
Fields:
  - salesreasonid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Identifier for the sales reason or justification code associated with this order (e.g., promotion, competitive match, new purchase)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when this sales order-to-reason association was last updated
  - salesorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Reference to the specific sales order header this sales reason applies to
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 8: adventureworks.sales.salesorderheader ---
Domain: SalesOrder
Description: General sales order information.
Fields:
  - accountnumber (character varying(15)): External customer account identifier used for billing and financial reconciliation
  - orderdate (timestamp without time zone): Calendar date when the customer placed or the system recorded the sales order
  - customerid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the customer entity who initiated and is responsible for the order
  - subtotal (numeric): Aggregate monetary value of all line items before applying taxes and freight charges
  - totaldue (numeric): Final amount payable by the customer including subtotal, taxes, freight, and any additional charges
  - shipdate (timestamp without time zone): Date when goods left the warehouse or fulfillment center for delivery to the customer
  - salespersonid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Identifier of the sales representative who facilitated or is credited with the order
  - shiptoaddressid (integer(32,0)): Reference to the physical destination address where ordered goods will be delivered
  - billtoaddressid (integer(32,0)): Reference to the address where the invoice will be sent and payment is expected
  - rowguid (uuid): Unique identifier for database replication and synchronization purposes across systems
  - shipmethodid (integer(32,0)): Carrier or shipping service level selected for delivering the order (e.g., ground, express, overnight)
  - purchaseordernumber (character varying(25)): Optional customer-provided purchase order reference number for B2B transactions
  - status (smallint(16,0)): Numeric code indicating the current stage in the order lifecycle such as pending, processing, shipped, or cancelled
  - comment (character varying(128)): Free-form text field for special instructions, customer requests, or internal notes about the order
  - creditcardid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to stored payment card information used for transaction processing
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 9: adventureworks.sales.specialoffer ---
Domain: Promotion
Description: Sale discounts lookup table.
Fields:
  - category (character varying(50)): The product category to which the special offer applies (e.g., Electronics, Apparel).
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when the special offer record was last updated.
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when the special offer expires and is no longer valid.
  - type (character varying(50)): The type of discount or promotion (e.g., Percentage, Fixed Amount, Buy X Get Y).
  - maxqty (integer(32,0)): The maximum quantity of items that can be purchased under this special offer.
  - description (character varying(255)): A textual description of the special offer for display or reference.
  - specialofferid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: A unique identifier for each special offer record, serving as the primary key.
  - rowguid (uuid): A globally unique identifier (GUID) used for replication and cross‑database reference.
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when the special offer becomes effective and can be applied.
  - discountpct (numeric): The discount percentage applied to qualifying items (e.g., 0.10 for 10%).
  - minqty (integer(32,0)): The minimum quantity of items required to qualify for the special offer.
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 10: adventureworks.humanresources.employee ---
Domain: Human Resources
Description: Employee information such as salary, department, and title.
Fields:
  - organizationnode (character varying): Hierarchical position identifier within the organization's structure for reporting relationships and org chart navigation
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp of the most recent modification to the employee record
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to the row for replication and data synchronization purposes
  - currentflag (boolean): Boolean indicating whether the employee is currently active in the organization
  - sickleavehours (smallint(16,0)): Accumulated sick leave hours available for the employee to use
  - vacationhours (smallint(16,0)): Accumulated vacation hours available for the employee to use
  - salariedflag (boolean): Boolean indicating whether the employee is paid a fixed salary versus hourly wages
  - hiredate (date): Date when the employee was officially hired and began employment
  - gender (character(1)): Employee's gender code for demographic reporting and legal compliance
  - maritalstatus (character(1)): Employee's marital status (M for married, S for single) for tax withholding and benefits purposes
  - birthdate (date): Employee's date of birth used for age verification and benefits eligibility
  - jobtitle (character varying(50)): Official job title or position held by the employee within the organization
  - loginid (character varying(256)): Employee's network login credential for system authentication
  - nationalidnumber (character varying(15)): Government-issued identification number (such as Social Security Number) used for tax and legal compliance
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key identifier for the employee entity in the system
